# QuizForge rules

- Project: React + Vite frontend in `client/src`. Backend is Vercel serverless in `client/api`.
- Current task: UI redesign only (landing page, animations, fonts, styling, responsive).
- Do NOT edit: `client/api/**`, `server/**`, `.env*`, `client/public/sitemap.xml`, `client/public/google9430d286b59cdc50.html`, the google-site-verification tag in `client/index.html`.
- Do not change API calls, routes, localStorage keys or data logic.
- The website text must be 100% English. Keep it simple and student friendly.
- Use only free tools and libraries (framer-motion, lucide-react, Google Fonts are fine).
- Make small changes, one page or component at a time.
- Keep the page titles and `usePageMeta` calls.
